svg.aria-label: Bar chart: how often punctuation alone names the author when one of the ten tracked marks is left out of the fingerprint, against 35.5% with all ten, counting one copy of each work. Without the period: 31.2%. Without the colon: 31.6%. Without the comma: 31.8%. Without the exclamation mark: 32.7%. Without the semicolon or parentheses: 32.9%. Without the apostrophe: 33.3%. Without the question mark: 33.5%. Without the dash: 33.6%. Without the double quote: 34.1%. No single mark carries the signature.
svg.text: NO SINGLE MARK CARRIES THE AUTHOR’S SIGNATURE
Share of books matched to the right author, with one mark left out of the fingerprint
